name: Immutable plan versions
rule: Published plan versions are immutable; commercial changes create a new effective version.

name: Deterministic entitlement resolution
rule: Effective access is resolved from plan version, add-ons, contract overrides, trial state and approved flags without hidden manual bypass.

name: Security is not an entitlement
rule: Commercial entitlement cannot override Phase 28 security, authorization, privacy or tenant-isolation controls.

name: Operational continuity
rule: Commercial suspension/cancellation behavior follows explicit policy and must not corrupt or silently delete tenant operational data.

name: Idempotent usage
rule: Usage events use idempotency keys/business identity to prevent duplicate billing or quota consumption.

name: Usage traceability
rule: Invoice usage lines trace to meter definition, aggregation period and underlying accepted usage evidence.

name: Proration reproducibility
rule: Proration inputs, time basis, currency, plan/price versions and calculation results are reproducible.

name: Invoice immutability
rule: Issued invoices are not silently edited; corrections use governed credits/adjustments/reissuance policy.

name: Payment provider abstraction
rule: Provider state is synchronized through a controlled adapter; provider metadata does not become the sole internal source of commercial truth.

name: Failed payment policy
rule: Dunning, grace, suspension and reactivation follow versioned policy and preserve audit evidence.

name: Trial eligibility
rule: Trial eligibility, duration, conversion and repeat-trial policy are explicit and auditable.

name: Promotion eligibility
rule: Promotions/coupons enforce eligibility, redemption limits, effective dates and stacking rules.

name: Seat enforcement
rule: Seat-based plans enforce licensed seat count according to hard/soft overage policy.

name: Quota enforcement
rule: Usage/storage/API/AI/project limits expose consumption and threshold state before configured enforcement where feasible.

name: Enterprise overrides
rule: Negotiated overrides require explicit scope, approver, effective period and precedence.

name: Grandfathering
rule: Legacy customers retain only explicitly grandfathered plan/price versions; migrations are recorded.

name: White-label isolation
rule: Tenant/reseller branding cannot alter another tenant or platform security identity.

name: Custom domain verification
rule: Custom domains require ownership verification and managed certificate/security lifecycle.

name: Branded communication safety
rule: Custom email/document branding cannot spoof unauthorized senders or remove required legal/security notices.

name: Support entitlement
rule: Support tier affects service channel/SLA eligibility but cannot change product security authorization.

name: Partner attribution
rule: Reseller/partner access and revenue attribution are explicit, tenant-approved where required, and auditable.

name: Marketplace entitlement
rule: Marketplace/integration access requires both commercial entitlement and technical/security authorization.

name: API commercial limits
rule: API plan limits are enforced separately from abuse/security rate limiting; security controls always take precedence.

name: Cancellation export
rule: Configured cancellation/offboarding may offer permitted export windows without bypassing retention/privacy/legal policy.

name: Tax evidence
rule: Tax determination retains jurisdiction, inputs, provider/rule version and result evidence when applicable.

name: Currency consistency
rule: Subscription/invoice calculations use explicit currency and governed conversion policy; original commercial amounts are preserved.

name: Revenue reconciliation
rule: Commercial analytics reconcile subscriptions, invoices, credits, payments and usage under defined rules.

name: No silent access expansion
rule: Billing correction, refund or payment success cannot silently grant capabilities outside effective entitlements.

name: Commercial SoD
rule: Sensitive plan publishing, credits, write-offs, refunds, contract overrides and manual entitlement actions use role/separation controls.

name: Commercial correction trace
rule: Manual correction retains reason, prior state, new state, actor/approval and impacted billing/access records.

name: Customer communication
rule: Material plan, price, renewal, suspension and deprecation notices follow configurable policy and evidence.

name: Feature deprecation
rule: Deprecated features have effective dates, impacted plan mapping and customer migration/communication controls.
